none: PAS NLM-2317E2: Roman Coin: Radiate of Postumus
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Postumus (260-269), Cunetio no. 2449, Reece period 13. Chipped. Obverse description: Radiate bust bearded draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]OSTVMVS(--)PF AVG. Reverse description: Male helmeted nude, Jove, standing left but gazing right with slanting spear cradled on right arm and a figure of eight shaped shield or a bow on his left arm. Reverse inscription: IOV [I S]TATO[RI]. Diameter: 19.5mm, Weight: 1.60gms, die axis: 12
